name: NBER Race and Stratification in the Economy, 2027 Conference
organizer: NBER Working Group on Race and Stratification in the Economy; organized by Jamein Cunningham, Ellora Derenoncourt and Jhacova Williams
submission_requirements: Completed papers uploaded via the NBER submission portal; considered for both longer and short (10-minute) presentations unless noted; papers that will be published by March 2027 should not be submitted; early-career and non-NBER scholars welcome. NBER can cover one presenter per paper for presenters without research funds
